description:
## v1.0.2

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* Compile patches to DEX (buildAndroid) so Morphe Manager can load the bundle — previous releases shipped JVM .class files with no classes.dex, which Manager rejects (0 patches / infinite load).

### ✨ Patches

* **Hide ads:** Removes all inline banner and native ads across the Me caller-ID app.
* **Disable interstitial ads:** Skips full-screen interstitials, including the one on launch.

Target: com.nfo.me.android 7.17.47

patches.name: Disable interstitial ads
patches.description: Skips full-screen interstitial ads (including the one on launch). Calls the app's own "no ad, continue" callback so navigation is unaffected.

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description: Removes all inline banner and native ads (call log, contacts, dialer, caller pop-up, profiles, menu, etc.) by neutering the ad host views.

release_notes: Fix: patches now compiled to DEX so Morphe Manager can load them (prior releases had no classes.dex → 0 patches). Patches: Hide ads, Disable interstitials. Target com.nfo.me.android 7.17.47.
